title: SFX -- new chart (unfurl)
_note: A Wayfarer's Chart is discovered (first steps into a new place): a soft paper swish up into two quiet music-box notes -- curiosity, not triumph (world-gleam is reserved for the Gleams and Gifts). ~0.6 s. Render --tail 0.35 to .wav, then ffmpeg -af volume=-5dB -> .mp3.
